name: dl-engine
description: Teach from the dl-engine corpus with citations. One connector reads every subject you are assigned: prepare a concept, sweep a theme, audit the connection map, and trace a past paper question back to the lessons that teach it, every claim carrying its lesson slug and line number.

api_key.title: dl-engine API key
api_key.description: Optional. Mint a key on the dl-engine plugin page at https://dlengine.xyz/plugin and keep it here for reference. The folder-level .mcp.json that /dl-engine:setup writes reads DL_ENGINE_KEY from your shell environment instead, so leave this blank if you already export that variable.
